movelist.name: Dynamax Cannon
movelist.effect: The DB of Dynamax Cannon increases by +2 for each positive CS the target has, to a maximum of DB 20.

movelist.name: Cross Poison
movelist.effect: Cross Poison is a Critical Hit on 18+, and Poisons the target on 19+.

movelist.name: Dragon Dance
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Speed 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Venoshock
movelist.effect: If the target is Poisoned, Venoshock has a Damage Base of 13 (4d10+10 / 35) instead.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: All foes within 3 meters are Suppressed for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Regal Challenge
abilities.effect: Ask the target if they will show deference or defiance. If they choose Deference, the target loses their next Shift action and loses 3 CS in the Stat of the user’s choice.  If they choose Defiance, the user gains a +10 Bonus to all Damage Rolls for the rest of the Scene.

abilities.name: Aura Break
abilities.effect: The foe reveals its abilities. Pick one ability; any Damage Bonuses (either Damage Base increases or Damage Roll bonuses) granted by the ability instead become Damage Penalties of the same value.
